brief:
Gaza's petroleum authority announced the entry of five truckloads of cooking gas into the territory on Tuesday, Shehab Wire reported. The shipment arrived as the enclave continues to face acute fuel shortages that have disrupted daily life across residential areas and essential services. Officials said the gas would be distributed to citizens according to predetermined allocation lists already made public.

The delivery represents one of the few fuel consignments to reach Gaza in recent months amid the ongoing blockade. Cooking gas has become increasingly scarce, forcing residents to rely on alternative and often dangerous methods for preparing food and heating. The authority did not specify when residents would receive their allocations or provide details on the volume contained in each truck.
